name: Claude Sonnet 5

weak.d: 80% of its benchmarks are run by no other lab — the highest single-lab share of any Claude card.

res.d: 58 disclosed evaluations, weighted heavily toward biosecurity.

lims: 80% lab-unique — almost nothing on this card is cross-comparable.
Biosecurity weighting — the disclosed suite is dominated by virology and synthesis screening.
Capability tables — not machine-extractable from the published PDF.
blurb: 58 disclosed evaluations, 80% of them run by no other lab. The published suite leans heavily toward biosecurity rather than the capability benchmarks peers report.

ability.name: Above Its Tier
ability.text: Beats Opus 4.8 on Terminal-bench 2.1 at roughly half the price, the first Sonnet to outperform the concurrent flagship on agentic coding.
